questions.q_en: Who among the following was one of the recipients of the inaugural 'Prof CR Rao Centenary Gold Medal' award in 2021?
questions.solution_en:
The Prof CR Rao Centenary Gold Medal was instituted in honor of the renowned statistician Calyampudi Radhakrishna Rao (C.R. Rao). The inaugural award in 2021 was given to Jagdish Bhagwati and C. Rangarajan for their outstanding contributions to economic theory and policy.

  • Jagdish Bhagwati is a distinguished economist known for his work in international trade and economic development.
  • C. Rangarajan is a former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India and a well-regarded economist in monetary policy.
questions.solution_hi: प्रोफेसर सी.आर. राव शताब्दी स्वर्ण पदक प्रसिद्ध सांख्यिकीविद् कल्यमपुडी राधाकृष्ण राव (सी.आर. राव) के सम्मान में स्थापित किया गया। 2021 में पहला पुरस्कार जगदीश भगवती व सी. रंगराजन को आर्थिक सिद्धांत व नीति में उनके उत्कृष्ट योगदान हेतु दिया गया।

questions.q_en: Harivarasanam award is given in the field of music by which of the following state governments?
questions.solution_en: The Harivarasanam award is given by the Kerala state government. It is named after the famous Sanskrit hymn "Harivarasanam" sung at the Sabarimala temple. This prestigious award recognizes excellence in music and contributions to the field of devotional music. The award includes a cash prize, citation, and plaque.
questions.solution_hi: हरिवरासनम पुरस्कार केरल राज्य सरकार द्वारा दिया जाता है। इसका नाम सबरीमाला मंदिर में गाए जाने वाले प्रसिद्ध संस्कृत भजन "हरिवरासनम" के नाम पर रखा गया है। यह प्रतिष्ठित पुरस्कार संगीत में उत्कृष्टता व भक्ति संगीत क्षेत्र में योगदान को मान्यता देता है।

questions.q_en: When was the Sri Shanmukhananda National Eminence Award set up?
questions.solution_en: To provide a national framework for honouring veterans in the field of performing arts, as well as emerging stars, Sri Shanmukhananda National Eminence Award was set up in the Golden Jubilee year, 2002 with the title 'Sangeetha Kala Vibhushan'.
questions.solution_hi: प्रदर्शन कला क्षेत्र में दिग्गजों व उभरते सितारों को सम्मानित करने हेतु राष्ट्रीय ढाँचा प्रदान करने हेतु, श्री षणमुखानंद राष्ट्रीय प्रतिभा पुरस्कार स्वर्ण जयंती वर्ष, 2002 में 'संगीता कला विभूषण' शीर्षक के साथ स्थापित किया गया।

questions.q_en: Which of the following awards is presented for lifetime achievement in sports and games? It was instituted to honour those sportspersons who have contributed to sports by their performance and continue to contribute to the promotion of sports even after their retirement from an active sporting career.
questions.solution_en:
The Dhyanchand Award is India's highest lifetime achievement award in sports and games, named after hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.

Key Features:

· Purpose: Honors retired sportspersons for their lifetime contributions to sports through performance and post-retirement promotion.

· Instituted in: 2002 (replacing the earlier Lifetime Achievement Award).

· Includes: ₹10 lakh cash prize, a statuette, and a scroll of honor.

Further information:

· Arjuna Award - For consistent outstanding performance (active athletes).

· Dronacharya Award - For excellence in coaching.

· Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna - Does not exist; the Khel Ratna (now Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna) is India's highest sporting honor for active athletes (renamed in 2021).
questions.solution_hi:
ध्यानचंद पुरस्कार भारत का खेलों व खेल-कूद में आजीवन उपलब्धि हेतु सर्वोच्च पुरस्कार है, जिसका नाम हॉकी के दिग्गज मेजर ध्यानचंद के नाम पर रखा गया है।

मुख्य विशेषताएँ:

• उद्देश्य: सेवानिवृत्त खिलाड़ियों को उनके खेलों में आजीवन योगदान हेतु सम्मानित करना।

questions.q_en: The government of which state started the Tansen Samman?
questions.solution_en:
The Tansen Samman is a prestigious music award instituted by the Government of Madhya Pradesh.

It is presented during the Tansen Music Festival held annually in Gwalior to honor outstanding contributions in the field of Hindustani classical music.

Established in 1980, the award initially offered a sum of Rs. 5,000, which was increased to Rs. 50,000 in 1986, and to Rs. 1 lakh in 1990.

Currently, the award carries a sum of Rs. 5 lakh. The purpose of this award is to honor significant contributions in the field of arts and to acknowledge the contributions of citizens to the cultural realm.

questions.solution_hi:
तानसेन सम्मान मध्य प्रदेश सरकार द्वारा स्थापित एक प्रतिष्ठित संगीत पुरस्कार है।

यह ग्वालियर में प्रतिवर्ष आयोजित तानसेन संगीत समारोह के दौरान हिंदुस्तानी शास्त्रीय संगीत क्षेत्र में उत्कृष्ट योगदान के सम्मान में प्रदान किया जाता है।

1980 में स्थापित, यह पुरस्कार शुरुआत में 5,000 रुपये की राशि प्रदान करता था, जो बाद में बढ़ाई गई।

questions.q_en: The SASTRA Ramanujan Prize is awarded in the field of _______.
questions.solution_en: The Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) Ramanujan Prize is awarded every year to a young mathematician judged to have done outstanding work in Ramanujan's fields of interest.
questions.solution_hi: शण्मुखा आर्ट्स, साइंस, टेक्नोलॉजी एंड रिसर्च एकेडमी (SASTRA) रामानुजन पुरस्कार हर वर्ष एक युवा गणितज्ञ को दिया जाता है जिसने रामानुजन के रुचि क्षेत्रों में उत्कृष्ट कार्य किया हो।

questions.q_en: Sangeet Natak Akademi Award was constituted in which of the following years?
questions.solution_en: The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, also known as the Akademi Puraskar was constituted in 1952. It is the highest Indian recognition given to people in the field of performing arts.
questions.solution_hi: संगीत नाटक अकादमी पुरस्कार, जिसे अकादमी पुरस्कार भी कहा जाता है, 1952 में स्थापित किया गया। यह प्रदर्शन कला क्षेत्र में लोगों को दी जाने वाली सर्वोच्च भारतीय मान्यता है।

questions.q_en: Most major sports awards are accompanied by a cash reward. Which of the following is the only national sports award that does NOT include a cash reward?
questions.solution_en:
The Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar is the only one that typically does not involve a direct cash reward for individuals.

This award promotes sports development by organizations or individuals but is not a personal athlete award and typically does not include a cash prize.

Other options:

b) Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna: India's highest sporting honor, it includes a significant cash reward (e.g., ₹25 lakh as of recent years).

c) Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy: Awarded to the top-performing university in inter-university sports, it includes a trophy and a small cash prize (e.g., ₹15 lakh).

d) Dronacharya Award: Given to coaches for outstanding contributions, it includes a cash prize (e.g., ₹15 lakh).
questions.solution_hi:
राष्ट्रीय खेल प्रोत्साहन पुरस्कार ही एकमात्र ऐसा पुरस्कार है जिसमें आमतौर पर व्यक्तियों हेतु सीधा नकद पुरस्कार शामिल नहीं होता।

यह पुरस्कार संगठनों या व्यक्तियों द्वारा खेल विकास को बढ़ावा देता है परंतु यह व्यक्तिगत खिलाड़ी पुरस्कार नहीं है व आमतौर पर इसमें नकद पुरस्कार शामिल नहीं होता।

questions.q_en:
Which of the following statement is / are correct?

I. Gandhi Peace Prize is an annual award instituted by Government of India since 1995.

II.The award is open to all persons regardless of nationality, race, language, caste, creed or sex.

III.The Gandhi Peace Prize for the year 2020 was conferred on Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
questions.solution_en:
• Gandhi Peace Prize is an annual award instituted by Government of India since 1995, the 125th Birth Anniversary commemoration year of Mahatma Gandhi.

• The award is open to all persons regardless of nationality, race, language, caste, creed or sex.

• The Gandhi Peace Prize for the year 2020 was conferred on Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman
questions.solution_hi:
• गांधी शांति पुरस्कार भारत सरकार द्वारा 1995 से, महात्मा गांधी की 125वीं जयंती स्मृति वर्ष से, स्थापित एक वार्षिक पुरस्कार है।

• यह पुरस्कार राष्ट्रीयता, नस्ल, भाषा, जाति, पंथ या लिंग की परवाह किए बिना सभी व्यक्तियों हेतु खुला है।

• वर्ष 2020 का गांधी शांति पुरस्कार बंगबंधु को प्रदान किया गया।

questions.q_en: The Nandi Award for Best Male Playback Singer was instituted by which state in the year 1977?
questions.solution_en: The Nandi Awards are prestigious awards presented by the Government of Andhra Pradesh to recognize excellence in Telugu cinema, theatre, and television. It includes various categories, one of which is the Best Male Playback Singer, instituted in 1977.
questions.solution_hi: नंदी पुरस्कार आंध्र प्रदेश सरकार द्वारा तेलुगु सिनेमा, रंगमंच व टेलीविजन में उत्कृष्टता को मान्यता देने हेतु प्रदान किए जाने वाले प्रतिष्ठित पुरस्कार हैं। इसमें विभिन्न श्रेणियाँ शामिल हैं, जिनमें से एक सर्वश्रेष्ठ पुरुष पार्श्व गायक है, जो 1977 में स्थापित हुई।
